mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, approval_instance_id, approval_node_id, recipient_user_id, delivery_key, template_code, status_code, message_id, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error_code, send_time, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, channel_code, provider_reference_id, last_attempt_time, correlation_id FROM cut_approval_notification WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND channel_code = 'IN_PLATFORM' AND (status_code = 'PENDING' OR (status_code = 'PENDING_RETRY' AND next_retry_time <= #{query.dueAt})) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_time, create_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{query.batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT id, tenant_id, approval_instance_id, approval_node_id, recipient_user_id, delivery_key, template_code, status_code, message_id, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error_code, send_time, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, channel_code, provider_reference_id, last_attempt_time, correlation_id FROM cut_approval_notification WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND channel_code IN ('SMS','EMAIL','DINGTALK') AND (status_code = 'PENDING' OR (status_code = 'PENDING_RETRY' AND next_retry_time <= #{query.dueAt})) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_time, create_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{query.batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
